name: object_detection.v1
description: Detects and classifies visual objects from an RGB image.

img.description: RGB image in planar NCHW format. Channels are ordered as Red, Green, then Blue.

id.description: Class name for each detected object, encoded as UTF-8 bytes.

score.description: Confidence score for each detected object.

name.description: Class name for each detected object, encoded as UTF-8 bytes.

box.description: Bounding boxes for each detected object (x, y, x_end, and y_end).
